issue.title: 1.8: Make npm audit a real CI gate after W1/W4 security bumps

affected_files.role: security job runs `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` with continue-on-error: true — findings never fail the build

analysis.summary: The security job's npm audit step is decorated with continue-on-error: true, so audit output is informational only — no new high/critical vulnerability can ever fail a PR. The gate was intentionally softened while known W1/W4 findings (issues #15-#17) were pending. Once those bumps land, the flag must be dropped (or replaced with a high+-only allowlist containing only vite until task 2.2).
analysis.details: Current implementation: .github/workflows/ci.yml security job -> `run: npm audit --audit-level=moderate` with `continue-on-error: true` (verified). Limitation: the CI security gate is a no-op; a regression introducing a critical dependency vulnerability ships green. Change surface: single workflow file, one step. Constraint: dropping the flag before #15 (audit fix), #16 (vitest), and #17 (sharp) land will immediately redden CI on the still-open findings, so this issue is sequenced strictly after those three land. Option: fail on high+ with an explicit allowlist that contains only vite until the 2.2 vite major bump, if the strict gate is too noisy. Closes F-CI-004.

options.name: Drop continue-on-error
options.summary: Remove continue-on-error: true from the npm audit step so audit failures fail the security job.

files_to_modify.changes: delete continue-on-error: true from the Run npm audit step

cons: Any future moderate finding blocks PRs — may be noisier than desired
options.risk_details: Pure CI config; gated on #15-#17 landing first or CI goes red immediately.

options.name: High+ gate with vite-only allowlist
options.summary: Run npm audit failing on high+ and filter allowlisted advisories (only vite, until task 2.2) via an audit script step.

files_to_modify.changes: replace plain audit step with gate script honoring a small allowlist

pros: Blocks new high/critical while tolerating the known vite finding
cons: Allowlist needs pruning at 2.2 or it rots
Slightly more moving parts than deleting one line
options.risk_details: Allowlist drift is the only hazard; bounded to one entry.
